scope: The fixed 20 original reviewed clips, first completed run per arm (r1). Existing pilot repeats and supplemental clips are excluded from cohort totals. Totals use only clips with all three valid arms; uncertainty and unreviewed counts remain separate. Labels were visually reviewed by one assistant, with human confirmation pending; this is development recall, not held-out release accuracy. Miss-reason summaries describe diagnostics near the reference time; they are hints, not independently verified causes for every missed contact.
